automationNotes: Stack App (doc §Creating a Project). App URL UI phase: http://localhost:4000/# then JSON RTE phase: http://localhost:1268 per doc §Add JSON RTE UI Location. UI locations: App Configuration /config, Custom Field (Name as create flow D{unique8}, Path /custom-field, Data Type JSON), JSON RTE /dam.js. Doc banner may say ‘View Hosting Settings’; product matches View Hosting Settings cue in flow. **Product:** max-app limit may skip Create modal (reuse first Stack App). Basic Information app icon: data/fixtures/developer-hub-app-icon-dummy-512.png — PNG 512×512, under 1 MB, RGBA (transparent background with small opaque center tile per “transparent backgrounds preferred”). npm/RTE servers out of scope. Per doc §Install: after saving UI locations (incl. JSON RTE), Install App (+ OAuth/consent/modal Install) — steps are required in this flow.
